cmp_scrap_hound.name: Scrap Hound
cmp_scrap_hound.description: A dungeon-bred mongrel stitched together from three other dogs and most of a toaster. Loyal to whoever fed it last, which, regrettably, was you.

spawned: COMPANION ASSIGNED: one Scrap Hound. Batteries not included. Rabies possibly included.
downed: Your hound is down. It is still technically a good boy. Revive it before the floor files it under loot.
Companion incapacitated. The System reminds you that pets are a privilege, not a strategy.
The Scrap Hound has stopped wagging. Stand over it and look sorry.
Hound down. Viewers are already drafting the memorial montage.
revived: Companion restored. It has forgiven you. It has not forgotten.
The Scrap Hound is back on its feet and holding a grudge against the floor.
Revival complete. Please do not ask where the replacement parts came from.
stay: Hound ordered to stay. It is pretending it did not hear you, but it is staying.
follow: Hound released. It resumes following you at an emotionally supportive distance.
